rationale: Series B (deep_agent) demonstrates superior tutorial quality across all evaluation criteria. The deep_agent series provides comprehensive, accurate implementations with complete code examples that align with the framework's architecture. Key strengths include: 1) Complete runnable examples with proper imports and class definitions, 2) Logical progression from basic concepts to advanced features, 3) Detailed explanations of framework components like LitAgent, Trainer, and various algorithms, 4) Practical examples including distributed execution and monitoring. In contrast, the baseline series, while covering similar topics, lacks the depth and completeness of the deep_agent tutorials, with more fragmented code snippets and less comprehensive coverage of the framework's capabilities.
